_comment: Regression reference: byte-for-byte the old test_bidir_rx_capture.py behavior, including its original sm_id layout (channels 2-4 are TX-only and never touch IRQ4, so sitting on PIO0 alongside the bidir pair is not itself a hazard). Channel 1 only bidirectional (the only channel ever proven bidir before this scenario engine existed); channels 2-4 stay TX-only, idle at 0. min_record_rate_hz=500 (not the old design's ~650/s): the wider 21-field record (vs the old 6-field one) costs more per completed reply even fully optimized (flat arrays, unrolled loop) - confirmed with clean, power-verified single-channel runs at 566-588/s (2026-08-30_20-55-33 and 21-06-28), so 500 leaves real margin without being toothless. This specific long-duration file has not itself been rerun since the driver settled - only the shorter single_channel_smoke.json has, at the numbers above.
